name: BabySmile Cartoon Face Petals Type Liquid Silicone Pacifier 1pcs
description:
BabySmile Cartoon Face Petals Type Liquid Silicone Pacifier 1pcs 
MADE IN CHINA 
Made from food grade silicone,safe and non toxic 
BPA free,bite resistance and durable. 
Elastic and soft,good for baby to bite. 
Baby pacifier is a must for baby when not nursing for them,and can immediately stop them crying.Round-shape head will be highly simulated from mom breast,therefore,this type of nipple is the best choice for your baby.
